nodes.rationale: Any AI agent modification must pass pytest, start via start.sh, verify pages/API in browser, and review structured logs before claiming delivery complete. Prevents untested or broken deployments.
nodes.norm_label: product delivery gate — test→start→verify→logs closed loop

nodes.label: PriceSeries — unified daily price data structure
nodes.rationale: All capabilities (yearly, monthly, backtest, crash-stats, VIX) derive from a single PriceSeries daily-data layer, ensuring consistency and avoiding per-endpoint fetcher duplication.
nodes.norm_label: priceseries — unified daily price data structure

nodes.label: Multi-Level Cache Architecture (L1→L2→L3)
nodes.rationale: Three-tier cache: L1 process memory for hot-instance speed, L2 Upstash Redis/Vercel KV for cross-instance sharing, L3 JSON snapshots for cold-start and upstream-failure fallback. Main TTL 6h success / 5min error.

nodes.label: L2 Upstash Redis / Vercel KV Cache
nodes.norm_label: l2 upstash redis / vercel kv cache

nodes.label: vercel.json Rewrite Check Mandate
nodes.rationale: New Flask routes must be added to vercel.json rewrites; Vercel only passes matched paths to Flask. Missing rewrites cause local-OK but production 404.

nodes.label: Fixed SEO Dates — no datetime.now() for lastmod
nodes.rationale: Sitemap and JSON-LD use fixed dates (INDEX_LASTMOD, ETF_MARKET_LASTMOD, KNOWLEDGE_ARTICLES.updated) rather than datetime.now() to avoid spurious diff churn and keep SEO signals stable.
nodes.norm_label: fixed seo dates — no datetime.now() for lastmod

nodes.label: No React/Vue/Build Tools — Classic JS Only
nodes.rationale: Frontend uses native HTML/CSS/classic JavaScript with SVG charts; no Node.js build pipeline, no framework. Keeps deployment simple and avoids build-step complexity on Vercel.
nodes.norm_label: no react/vue/build tools — classic js only

nodes.label: Data Source Fallback Chain
nodes.rationale: US stocks→Yahoo Finance; crypto→Binance→OKX→CoinGecko; A-shares→East Money/Tencent. Single upstream failure must not cascade; ThreadPoolExecutor for concurrent fetches.

nodes.label: Native SVG Charts — no charting library
nodes.norm_label: native svg charts — no charting library

nodes.label: Mandatory pytest Before Any Start
nodes.rationale: start.sh debug/start/restart all enforce pytest pass before launching Flask. Prevents broken code from reaching runtime. 306 tests covering computation, services, routes, ETF/QDII, SEO, stats, and logging.

nodes.label: Log Sanitization Policy — no tokens, cookies, IPs
nodes.rationale: Structured logs may include request IDs, sanitized paths, symbols, data sources, cache tier, result counts, status codes, and latency — but never tokens, cookies, full IPs, or wish message bodies.
nodes.norm_label: log sanitization policy — no tokens, cookies, ips

nodes.label: Knowledge Article SEO Addition Checklist
nodes.rationale: New knowledge articles require updating: KNOWLEDGE_ARTICLES, legacy_paths, Flask routes, vercel.json regex, frontend content/tab mapping, locale SEO copy, and SEO tests — a 7-step checklist to avoid partial deployment.

links.detail: This screenshot is a visual capture of the backtest tab as rendered in price-change.html, showing the complete parameter-to-results user flow.

The backtest form parameters (initial capital, monthly contribution, date range, asset selection) are submitted to the backtest API endpoint for computation; the results are rendered in the tab. This is the client-server contract visible in the screenshot's form-to-results layout.

The equity curve chart visible in the screenshot is drawn by the native SVG charting JavaScript after receiving backtest API response data. The chart toggle (log/linear) and axis labels confirm this is the same SVG rendering system used across the site.

Backtest computation depends on the PriceSeries daily data layer to fetch historical OHLCV for the selected asset. This dependency is structurally implied by the unified data architecture documented in CLAUDE.md.
